verdict.rationale: The built-in web UI runs directly against the `llama serve` HTTP API (gh-2, gh-3), implying the UI is just a client of the same endpoints an AI-native user could call directly, and vision/chat sessions are also exposed via `llama cli`/API (gh-4). However, there's no explicit documentation enumerating full UI-to-API parity or listing any UI-only features that might lack API equivalents. Missing for 10: explicit API reference confirming every UI feature (e.g. multimodal image upload, session management) has a documented API equivalent, and independent confirmation that no UI-exclusive functionality exists.
